bias.en: Neutral · pullback after the Oct 2 high, above the 30, 50 and 100-day
bias.zh: 中性 · 10月2日高点后回调，位于30、50及100日均线上方

read.en: Teradyne fell 10% from its Oct 2 close of $449 and now sits below the 5 and 10-day averages ($416–418) but above the 20-day ($392) and a cluster of the 30, 50 and 100-day averages near $381–383. MACD is still just above its signal line, but the histogram has shrunk for four days and is close to a bearish cross. RSI is 53, so the stock is neither stretched nor oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达由 10月2日收盘 $449 回落 10%，目前位于 5 日与 10 日均线（$416–418）下方，但在 20 日均线（$392）及约 $381–383 的 30、50、100 日均线密集区上方。MACD 仍略高于信号线，但柱体已连续四日收缩，接近死叉。RSI 为 53，既不过热也未超卖。

read.en: First support is $389, the Oct 8 low and a September pivot. Below that, the $381–383 average cluster matters most; a close under it would point back to the mid-September low near $329. Overhead, $416 comes first, then $444–452 where the Aug 17 and Oct 2 highs both stalled, and then the June record near $484–488. Earnings in late October can move the stock well beyond these levels.
read.zh: 首个支撑为 $389，即 10月8日低点及 9月转折位。其下 $381–383 的均线密集区最关键；若收盘跌破，下看 9月中旬低点约 $329。上方先看 $416，再看 8月17日与 10月2日两度受阻的 $444–452，然后是 6月纪录高位约 $484–488。10月下旬的财报可能令股价大幅越过这些价位。
